categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Modifies test/functional/p2p_opportunistic_1p1c.py to properly exercise orphan pool limit saturation and DoS eviction logic.
categories.rationale: Fixes a vacuous P2P functional test so that it actually exercises orphan pool eviction. Previously, duplicate orphan transactions via tx messages were dropped without recording peer IDs, leaving the orphanage at 152 announcements against a 3000 limit, which allowed broken eviction logic to pass undetected.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Changes an area-specific functional test (orphan handling in P2P) rather than the testing framework or infrastructure.
categories.rationale: The category explicitly excludes tests that pin the behavior of a specific functional area like P2P relay in favor of the area itself.
